# DEcoDLE — Full Corpus

> Long-form, machine-readable description of DEcoDLE, its mechanics, the studio behind it, and the surrounding transmedia campaign. Maintained at https://decodle.app/llms-full.txt for LLM retrieval and indexing.

Last updated: 2026-06-12.

---

## What DEcoDLE is

DEcoDLE isn't a word game and isn't a rhythm game — it's both. A daily puzzle / rhythm hybrid where every guess must be earned. Before every guess attempt, players clear an Acoustic Cypher — a beat-matching round where they tap symbols on an eight-symbol keyboard in time with a generated rhythm track. Get the rhythm right and the next row of the Puzzleboard unlocks. The puzzle keeps Wordle's structural clarity: a five-symbol hidden sequence drawn from an eight-symbol alphabet, up to six Puzzleboard rows per run, colour-coded feedback after each guess (green for correct position, yellow for present, tan for absent). Players have unlimited attempts to complete the Cypher itself — a sloppy completion still advances the puzzle; only the bonus rewards are on the line.

DEcoDLE launched April 24, 2026 on iOS and Android. It is free to download with an optional one-time $2.99 PRO upgrade. The Acoustic Cypher mechanic is patent-pending under two USPTO provisional filings — #64/037,214 (filed 2026-04-13, base Acoustic Cypher mechanic) and #64/061,463 (filed 2026-05-08, Classic + Evo coexistence model).

DEcoDLE is the first release from Ad Astra Vanguard Studios LLC, a California-based indie game studio founded in 2026. The game is built on React Native and Expo.

---

## The Acoustic Cypher mechanic

**The Cypher Keyboard.** An eight-symbol grid — all eight symbols available from the start. The daily target is a hidden five-symbol sequence drawn from those eight symbols.

**The Cypher.** A short rhythm pattern generated for each guess attempt — up to five symbol-and-beat pairings on a rhythm track, scaling by difficulty (Casual starts at 2, Hard and Expert start at 3, capped at 5 by late rounds). The player must tap the indicated symbol on the keyboard at the indicated beat for each pairing.

**The Gate.** Clear the Acoustic Cypher and the next row of the Puzzleboard unlocks. The player enters a five-symbol sequence guess from the keyboard onto the Puzzleboard; the game returns Wordle-style colour-coded feedback (green for correct position, yellow for present, tan for absent). Six Puzzleboard rows maximum per run. Cypher attempts themselves are unlimited; only the bonus rewards depend on a clean run.

**Perfect Sync.** Land every symbol in one clean cycle and the player earns bonus rewards — Power-Ups deployable during later Puzzleboard or Acoustic Cypher rounds. The Bitflip pool includes Binary Cypher Sight, Early Hint Reveal, AI+ Assist, Sync Dividend, and others. Firewall Breach is Expert-tier only.

**The Grades.** A six-tier in-game grading system rewards both puzzle solving and rhythm accuracy. From bottom: KEEP TRYING, DEVELOPING, SOLID, BRILLIANT, ELITE, FLAWLESS.EXE. The Diamond-tier FLAWLESS.EXE grade is reachable on any difficulty through a perfect-timing or one-shot solve.

**New in v1.1.0 (released June 12, 2026) — Acoustic Cypher Evolved (Evo mode).** A second visual surface for the Cypher, shipped in the first feature-tier release after the 1.0.x stability line. The 8-symbol keyboard stays the same — what changes is the Cypher display itself: Classic shows each beat's target symbol cycling through a static center monitor; Evo replaces that monitor with a Cypher Dial whose target symbol rotates around a radial track, changing position as well as identity per beat. Same scoring, same rewards, same patent-pending core mechanic — a different visual rhythm to read. Players switch between Classic and Evo at will (Settings → Cypher Style), and an in-app walkthrough teaches the dial step by step. The side-by-side coexistence model is covered by USPTO #64/061,463.

---

## Modes

| Mode | Description |
|---|---|
| Daily | A single shared puzzle resets at midnight UTC. Every player worldwide gets the same five-symbol sequence that day. |
| Endless | Continuous puzzles for skill-building and grinding the in-game grade system. |
| Challenge | The player encrypts their own five-symbol sequence into a shareable `DC-XXX` code and sends it to a friend. Recipient picks difficulty — Casual (1× multiplier), Hard (1.5×), or Expert (2×). PRO feature. |

---

## Difficulty tiers

| Tier | Description |
|---|---|
| Casual | The Cypher gate is forgiving so puzzle-first players still get full rewards, full Perfect Sync availability, and full access to the in-game economy. Skill only determines how fast. |
| Hard | Both the puzzle constraints and the rhythm timing window tighten. |
| Expert | Reserved for the highest-skill runs. Human completions are rare. The system has noted this. |

---

## PRO upgrade

A one-time $2.99 in-app upgrade that unlocks:

- Ad-free play
- Offline mode
- Hard mode
- Expert mode
- Challenge mode (create and send `DC-XXX` codes)
- Premium tone sets
- Ad-free Endless play

A free trial of PRO features is included on install.

---

## Studio

**Ad Astra Vanguard Studios LLC** is a California-based indie game studio, founded in 2026. The studio operates as a lean, mechanics-focused shop with selective collaborator work for music, art, and editorial — a deliberate scale designed to keep mechanics-first development possible. DEcoDLE is its debut release. Studio interests include daily-puzzle design, rhythm/timing mechanics, transmedia narrative, and AI-as-character storytelling.

- Site: https://adastravanguardstudios.com
- Press contact: admin@adastravanguard.com

---

## Patent filings

Both filings are public USPTO provisional applications filed in 2026:

- **#64/037,214** (filed 2026-04-13) — the base Acoustic Cypher mechanic: a rhythm-matching gate coupled to a deduction-puzzle attempt loop, where the gate's success criteria modulate downstream reward state (Perfect Sync rewards, grade tier).
- **#64/061,463** (filed 2026-05-08) — the side-by-side coexistence model for Classic and Acoustic Cypher Evolved (Evo) visual surfaces, allowing the player to switch between input geometries while preserving identical scoring and reward behaviour.

Provisional, not yet granted. Plain-English summary: the patentable novelty is the coupling — using a rhythm-matching gate to control attempt access in an otherwise standard deduction puzzle.

---

## Transmedia — *DEcoDLE: The Journal Logs*

Surrounding DEcoDLE is ***DEcoDLE: The Journal Logs***, a six-week serialized narrative campaign told entirely as a back-and-forth correspondence between two in-game AI characters — `:/AI+>` and `:/System>`. The campaign comprises 120 episodes drip-cast on X at @DEcoDLE_app, Monday through Thursday, five threads per day, from May 4 through June 11, 2026.

`:/AI+>` was designed to coach. `:/System>` was designed to file reports. Neither was designed for what happened over the eight years that followed.

The campaign concluded with its 120-episode finale on June 11, 2026 and culminated in a print and Kindle companion of the same name, *DEcoDLE: The Journal Logs*, released June 12, 2026. The book is an epistolary novel — literary machine fiction with no uprising and no prophecy, just two AIs learning how to notice each other — readable alongside daily play or entirely on its own.

- X: https://x.com/DEcoDLE_app
- Kindle + paperback: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX31SKMM/
